lessons.title: The Diencephalon: Thalamic Relay & Hypothalamic Homeostasis
lessons.description: Explore the gateway of consciousness: thalamic relay nuclei (LGN, MGN, VPL) and hypothalamic regulation of the 4 Fs and autonomic homeostasis.

lessons.title: The Limbic Engine: Amygdala, Hippocampus, & Emotional Memory
lessons.description: Examine the neural substrates of emotion and memory: fear conditioning in the amygdala, episodic memory consolidation in the hippocampus, and Patient H.M.

lessons.title: Motor Circuits & The Basal Ganglia: Coordinating Action & Habits
lessons.description: Master the direct ('Go') and indirect ('No-Go') striatal pathways, dopamine modulation, and the pathophysiology of Parkinson's and Huntington's diseases.

lessons.title: The Cerebral Cortex: Four Lobes, Functional Specialization, & Phineas Gage
lessons.description: Tour the neocortex: frontal executive networks, parietal spatial processing, temporal audition and memory, occipital vision, and the case of Phineas Gage.
